name: Olsalazine Sodium

similar.name: Exifone
problems: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1989 — for liver harm

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Renal Impairment : Assess renal function at the beginning of treatment and periodically during treatment. Discontinue DIPENTUM if renal function deteriorates while on therapy. ( 5.1 , 7.1 ) • Mesalamine-Induced Acute Intolerance Syndrome : Discontinue treatment if acute intolerance…

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Olsalazine Sodium a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. A similar drug named Exifone was removed from the market in France due to liver harm [3]. Official warnings advise checking kidney function before and during treatment, and stopping the medicine if kidney function worsens [4]. Treatment should also be stopped if a sudden reaction called acute intolerance syndrome happens [4].
